description: Fast feudal timing with instant rush and transition
name: Feudal Rush (Onna Bugeisha)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Drop-off @resource/resource_food.webp@ and build @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.png@ on edge of @building_economy/town-center.png@
Start producing @unit_japanese/onna-bugeisha-2.webp@. Every time a @building_economy/farm.png@ spawns on the @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.png@ put a food villager there.
Send 5 vills to stone for @technology_japanese/daimyo-manor-1.webp@ then keep them there until @technology_japanese/daimyo-palace-2.png@
@technology_japanese/hizukuri-2.webp@ and transition either @building_military/archery-range.png@@building_military/stable.png@ depending on defensive units from opponent

Around 9-12 minutes is a good time to go @age/age_3.webp@ with @unit_japanese/samurai-1.png@ timing. If you do it later than that, your opponent is either full feudal or in castle already and the timing is lost. Always do @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.png@ (@landmark_japanese/temple-of-equality-2.png@ if up against @civilization_flag/dra.png@ or other small high quality comps)

description: Aussie Drongo walkthrough of Vortix's Japanese Fast Castle build
name: Japanese Fast Castle (Vortix)
author: dinotreehouse

notes: Rally on berries, 2 build @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@, 4 on @resource/berrybush.png@, research @technology_japanese/towara-1.png@ when house is built
Rally to gold, first Villager builds Forge
After 3 on gold, rally TC to sheep
Ready for age up with 4 villagers on sheep
Take Sheep Villagers and build Kura Storehouse on Wood line, Rally TC to wood
Move 2 Villagers from Storehouse to Gold, Move other 2 on Sheep, Rally TC on sheep, Move Sheep villagers to farms as they become available
5 Gold Villagers build Outpost to guard Gold
Take 5 Villagers off food, build 2nd outpost near gold and move to gold
Build another house with Wood or Food villager
Take 9-10 Villagers off food, build floating gate near TC
Take 1 Wood Villager and build Stable near Floating Gate
First Yorishiro into Stable, train Mounted Samurai, get @technology_japanese/takezaiku-2.webp@, Second Yorishiro into TC
Use priests to get Relics, Build Shrine with 4 Villagers off Gold. Use Mounted Samurai to protect priests
Build 2-3 Archery Range or Barracks to counter
Research Archer or Infantry upgrade, Research @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@ if going Archers

name: Beasty 2 TC Mass Onna-Samurai (inspired by DeMu and VortiX?) [detailed]

notes: first villager builds @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.png@ and stays there, @resource/rally.png@ to @resource/resource_stone.png@ until 5 (goal is to mine 650 total)

research @technology_japanese/daimyo-manor-1.webp@ at 300 @resource/resource_stone.png@, make sure it's right after the villager that is currently being made, also make sure NOT to queue up another villager before it finishes, as it will delay the free villager you get from the upgrade

4 @resource/sheep.webp@ villagers build @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.png@ (preferably 2 tiles away from @building_economy/town-center.png@), make sure not to destroy any @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ with it as you will need all 3 of them

all other @resource/sheep.webp@villagers (except 2) go to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@, rally to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@, @resource/berrybush.png@ villager will build the next house, also next to @resource/berrybush.png@

at 450 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (after all @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ are chopped) 8 villagers build second @building_economy/town-center.png@ on nearest @resource/resource_gold.png@, 6 go to @resource/resource_wood.png@ and build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@, age up should happen around the same time
send 2 age up villagers to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to get 8 total, others to food (1 on the first kura farm). @resource/rally.png@ to @resource/resource_food.png@

after @building_economy/town-center.webp@ is done, send those 8 villagers to the @resource/resource_gold.png@, research @technology_japanese/towara-1.png@, @resource/rally.png@ both @building_economy/town-center.png@ to @resource/resource_food.png@, build 2 @building_military/barracks.png@ with one @resource/resource_gold.png@ villager, start producing @unit_japanese/onna-bugeisha-2.png@ and at least one @unit_japanese/katana-bannerman-2.png@
research @technology_japanese/takezaiku-2.webp@ and@technology_economy/double-broadaxe.png@, and @technology_japanese/tatara-1.png@ next, build walls as needed
get economy upgrades and military ones that you need, you can harass, you can all in, or you can progress towards @age/age_3.webp@

use extra @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to build farms around your fist @building_economy/town-center.png@, add some @building_military/barracks.png@ as needed, around 11-12 minutes you can rally some villagers to @resource/resource_stone.png@ to get @technology_japanese/daimyo-palace-2.png@
13 villagers build @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@, also build 2 @building_japanese/forge-1.png@ next to it
If you need quick army production then put your @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ relics in military buildings, otherwise put them in @building_japanese/forge-1.png@

Get relics, get more @resource/resource_wood.webp@ so you can transition from @resource/berrybush.png@@resource/sheep.png@ to @building_economy/farm.png@ around your first tc (you should aim for like 30), build more @building_military/barracks.png@ as needed, get @technology_japanese/daimyo-palace-2.png@
make sure to get @technology_japanese/yaki-ire-4.webp@ and other important upgrades, get @technology_japanese/shogunate-castle-3.png@ when you can
Build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ on gold and upgrade this with @technology_defensive/arrow-slits.webp@@technology_defensive/fortify-outpost.webp@
Age up to @age/age_3.webp@ with @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ with 8 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@

Macro 5-8 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ depending on if u need @building_military/barracks.webp@ or @building_military/stable.webp@ (rax if getting all inned by wood units, stable if enemy knights or no enemy pressure)
@building_military/stable.webp@ and make @unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@ nonstop & take relics. Your go to comp is @unit_japanese/yumi-ashigaru-2.webp@ & @unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@

Split your first 6 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ according to tab. (2 @resource/resource_stone.png@, 1 @resource/resource_gold.png@, 3 @resource/resource_food.png@) and then @resource/rally.png@ new @unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ to @resource/resource_food.png@
Take 3 from @resource/resource_food.webp@ and put on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ and chop 2x @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@
When 225 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ pull your 2 @resource/resource_stone.png@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ to chop the 2x @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@.

Take 2 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ and build a @building_military/stable.png@ then @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.png@ & queue @unit_japanese/uma-bannerman-2.png@ to harass and defend (dont take unnecessary damage, you want him alive)
When 16 on @resource/resource_food.webp@ then @resource/rally.png@ new @unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@ until @age/age_3.png@
Setup barrack for Yorishiro in case of feudal and other necessities like walls and stuff
@resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.png@ and @resource/resource_food.png@. Spam @unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.png@ for Map Control and @resource/relics.png@.
Afterwards start prepping barracks to deal with enemy Spear/crossbow comp through the use of @unit_japanese/onna-bugeisha-2.webp@ spam. (dont forget full melee att upgrades for these)
Otherwise, you can choose to play the long or short game here. Again, be flexible and reactive, dont go 2nd TC if opponent is trying to kill you or you dont have control. Play intelligently :P
rally @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to @resource/sheep.png@ , build @building_military/barracks.png@ every 150 @resource/resource_wood.png@ until 4 or 5

name: Japanese Real FC - Copy for me to understand series
author: murtuk

notes: Send all @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@ after @technology_japanese/towara-1.webp@finishes to walk faster
After 1st@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ finish, 1 go back to @resource/sheep.webp@, others go to wood line near@landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@
After that, make 2x@building_military/archery-range.webp@, 10x@unit_japanese/yumi-ashigaru-2.webp@(at 10:45) and@building_economy/farm.webp@ and adjust Macro

send 4 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ to @abilities/repair.png@@landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.png@. Keep 4 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ on @resource/resource_food.png@, rest on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@,
Move 5 from @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@, if you have 350 @resource/resource_stone.png@.

Send 8 @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ to @abilities/repair.png@2nd @building_economy/town-center.png@on @resource/resource_gold.png@ and rally them all on @resource/resource_gold.png@afterward. Send 3 @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.png@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@, @abilities/repair.png@@building_economy/lumber-camp.png@. Send 1 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ to @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.png@ generated @building_economy/farm.png@ as they spawn. Farm @resource/berrybush.png@ if screwed on @resource/sheep.png@.

Build 1st @building_military/barracks.webp@ and make @unit_japanese/onna-bugeisha-2.png@, use extra @resource/resource_wood.png@ to make @building_defensive/palisade-wall.png@, more @building_military/barracks.png@, and @building_economy/farm.png@ around @building_economy/town-center.png@ and as needed.

research @technology_japanese/towara-1.webp@,@technology_japanese/takezaiku-2.png@,@technology_economy/double-broadaxe.png@,@technology_japanese/tatara-1.png@, and @technology_economy/specialized-pick.png@. Use 2+ @unit_japanese/onna-bugeisha-2.png@ to harass eco, always have @unit_japanese/katana-bannerman-2.png@.

Research @technology_japanese/hizukuri-2.webp@, hardened @unit_japanese/samurai-1.png@, and mass @unit_japanese/samurai-1.png@ + @unit_japanese/onna-bugeisha-2.png@ against regular units + @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.png@, or @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@ against knights.
@unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ opponent and determine whether to @age/age_3.png@ or mass units. add some @unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@ for Age up

When ready to advance, @abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.png@ with 12 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ and @abilities/repair.png@ 2 @building_japanese/forge-1.png@ next to it. Put @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.png@@resource/relics.png@ in @building_japanese/forge-1.png@ or military buildings (if being all in'd) as needed. Research ,@technology_military/decarbonization.png@,@technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.png@, and@technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@. Keep pop cap up with @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.png@. Start slowly get @resource/resource_stone.png@ for @technology_japanese/daimyo-palace-2.png@. add few more @unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ for update

Collect stone for @technology_japanese/daimyo-palace-2.webp@, start moving more @unit_worker/villager-japanese.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ to start pushing towards 40+@building_economy/farm.png@ and research @technology_economy/acid-distilization.png@,@technology_japanese/kobuse-gitae-3.png@,@technology_military/insulated-helm.png@,@technology_military/wedge-rivets.png@, and @technology_japanese/odachi-3.png@. Use extra @resource/resource_wood.png@ to mass @building_military/barracks.png@ and/or @building_military/archery-range.png@/@building_military/stable.png@.

Pull some @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.png@ to @resource/resource_stone.png@ to farm @technology_japanese/shogunate-castle-3.png@ for 70% @building_economy/farm.png@ bonus.

Get remaining upgrades/research, go @age/age_4.webp@ with @landmark_japanese/tanegashima-gunsmith-3.png@ or mass in castle. Make @unit_japanese/ozutsu-4.png@ from @landmark_japanese/tanegashima-gunsmith-3.png@, and mass @unit_japanese/samurai-1.png@ with @unit_japanese/onna-bugeisha-2.png@/@unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@/@unit_japanese/onna-musha-3.png@ and nuke buildings with @unit_japanese/ozutsu-4.png@ and siege depending on enemy comps.
Queue villager, rally to Sheep till 4
4 to House + Forge, then to Stone
5 from Stone to Wood (Straggler Tree), reached 200 Gold farming Stone
5 from Sheep to build Kura Storehouse
1 Sheep to build House, then back to Wood
12 villagers to build second TC near Gold
TC rally to sheep, 4 from wood to build Lumber Camp
8 to gold, 4 to wood from second TC
Build 2 Barracks with 8 villagers from Wood then house then to Berries
